hypothesis: The detection logic in CompressorStreamFactory.createCompressorInputStream is missing the specific signature check for zlib-headered deflate streams, preventing the factory from identifying and instantiating the correct compressor.
prediction: The fix will involve adding a new check for the zlib header signature within the detection logic of CompressorStreamFactory and providing the corresponding instantiation logic for the DeflateCompressorInputStream.
experiment_rationale: The failure occurs at the point where the factory attempts to match the stream signature against known compressor types. Since the code explicitly throws an exception when no match is found, and the bug report identifies this as a missing capability for a specific file format, the fix must be an extension of the detection algorithm.
reasoning_summary: The defect is a failure to detect a specific file format (deflate with zlib header). This is a procedural logic issue within the detection algorithm of the factory class. It is not a missing guard (Checking), not a wrong value (Assignment), and not a design-level capability gap (Function/Class/Object) because the infrastructure for handling compressors already exists; it simply lacks the specific algorithmic step to identify this variant.
evidence_used: Bug report description: 'CompressorStreamFactory doesn't handle deflate streams with a zlib header'
